'''Carl Mike Hardy Profitable Harvest''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Red 32's Star Wars CCG Site]] as '''Profitable Harvest'''. [[Carl Mike Hardy]] posted it on 25 April 2000.

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Carl Mike Hardy]]
* '''Published:''' 25 April 2000 (Red 32's Star Wars CCG Site)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Special Edition]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|You Can Either Profit By This...|EJP-L-youcaneitherprofitbythis.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Profitable Harvest
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PSE Profit Hardy LS 2000 Red32.txt |Download]]

== Strategy ==

This deck is based off of two very popular strategies that you'll find today, Profit and Harvest. It's rather straight forward in it's design and application. By starting with Uh-Oh and later using the Audience Chamber game text to grab Bo Shuda, you can keep the Audience Chamber (and Han) relatively safe from a Dark Side beatdown. Slapping down OTE later will make the DS think twice about sticking around the AC as well. Once the AC is vacated, you can spring Han at your leisure (retriveing yourself an easy 10 Force). Once Han's free, you can Force drain on Tatooine. Tessek and The H'nemthes will give you a plus one to the drain. The speeders and Maneuver Flaps give you some stronger back up and offer a cozy (Bubo free) place for Owen and Beru to do a little Harvesting for you. Toy with it to you taste.
